reason: I already have free budget apps, and I don't want to upload my credit-card statement or hand over my bank slips to a new website just to see my spending. The 69 baht is small, but the trust cost is what stops me.
objection: Why would I give a new app my card statement when my bank apps and free budget apps already show me this? I don't know who reads the PDF or what happens to the data after the trial.
would_change_my_mind: Slip capture that works entirely on my phone with no upload and no statement needed, plus a clear written promise that nothing leaves my device except the transaction details, and a way to delete everything.
